This page contains the source code, links, and slides for the **most relevant** workshops, seminars, talks, conferences and presentations I've given. Research presentations given at conferences are typically stored in their respective repositories on GitHub; one-off workshops and talks can all be found in a [catch-all GitHub repository](https://github.com/jrcarob).
